title: Crystal Ball Sequence
statementMd:
Crystal ball sequence on hexagonal lattice is defined as follows: $*n*$-th element is the number of lattice points inside a hexagon with $(*n* + 1)$ points on each side. The formula is $*H*_{*n*} = 3·*n*·(*n* + 1) + 1$. You are given $*n*$; calculate $*n*$-th element of the sequence.

## Input

The only line of input contains an integer $*n*$ ($0 ≤ *n* ≤ 9$).

## Output

Output the $*n*$-th element of crystal ball sequence.
